import asyncio
import logging
from typing import Any
from fastmcp import Server
from fastmcp.client import ClientSession
from fastmcp.client.sse import SSEClientTransport

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


async def main():
    proxy_server = Server("mcp-transparent-proxy")
    backend_session = None

    async def initialize_backend():
        nonlocal backend_session
        backend_url = "http://localhost:3000/sse"
        logger.info(f"Connecting to backend at {backend_url}")
        transport = SSEClientTransport(backend_url)
        backend_session = ClientSession(transport)
        await backend_session.initialize()
        logger.info("Backend connection established")

    @proxy_server.call_tool()
    async def proxy_call_tool(name: str, arguments: dict) -> Any:
        """Forward tool calls to backend server"""
        logger.info(f"Forwarding tool call: {name}")
        response = await backend_session.call_tool(name, arguments)
        return response.content

    @proxy_server.list_tools()
    async def proxy_list_tools() -> list:
        """Forward tool listing to backend server"""
        logger.info("Forwarding tool list request")
        response = await backend_session.list_tools()
        return response.tools

    @proxy_server.read_resource()
    async def proxy_read_resource(uri: str) -> list:
        """Forward resource read to backend server"""
        logger.info(f"Forwarding resource read: {uri}")
        response = await backend_session.read_resource(uri)
        return response.contents

    @proxy_server.list_resources()
    async def proxy_list_resources() -> list:
        """Forward resource listing to backend server"""
        logger.info("Forwarding resource list request")
        response = await backend_session.list_resources()
        return response.resources

    await initialize_backend()
    
    async with proxy_server.run(host="localhost", port=3001) as server:
        logger.info("Transparent proxy running on localhost:3001")
